column4: binding names, sequential: annotation+init incoming; later bindings and body shadowed
params: types and return incoming; body shadowed
arm pattern binders: scrutinee and patterns incoming; that arm body shadowed
index names (Foreach, nested Foreach2 outer/inner): types and bounds incoming; body shadowed
index: type, bounds, init incoming; value shadowed
index, prefix: types, bounds, init incoming; value (index), body (index or prefix) shadowed
index, slot: types, bounds, init incoming; keep (index), body (index or slot) shadowed
tc-with-region-rename-expr!: a same-named nested arena binds its own region; not entered
resource names, sequential: init and cleanup incoming; later bindings and body shadowed
slots 0-1 hygienic state/index Vars: slots 0-2 incoming; slot 3 body shadowed
slot 2 item Var: slots 0-4 incoming (negative kept); slot 5 body shadowed
